primary.name: first-hour gated TQQQ, 165d regime (2% band), 20d vol crash filter, 4% stop

rules.regime: QQQ close > 165d SMA*1.02 -> ON; < SMA*0.98 -> OFF; else hold state (signal at prior close)
rules.overnight: TQQQ from 15:59 open to 10:30 open next session when regime ON
rules.crash_filter: skip the overnight entry when QQQ 20d realised vol (through prior close) > 35% annualised
rules.afternoon: hold TQQQ from 10:30 to 15:59 iff QQQ first-hour return (09:30->10:29) >= -0.5%
rules.stop: while long, exit at next-minute open if TQQQ < session open*0.96 (rest of day, re-enter at 15:59)
